column1: # The PLAD entry of every campaign mission bundle: FHM child 2.
# tools/ac6_fhm.py. The archives are inputs and are never committed; this table
# is 33 records of 0x10 bytes and is.
# Layout, from 0x82249BA8 and 0x82249BC8 (cycle 1131): a 0x10-byte header whose
# word +0x08 is the record count, then `count` records of 0x10 bytes, each three
# big-endian floats and a word. The mission loader reads only the fourth word,
# indexing by the player slot at global+0x4B40, and stores it to +0xF0 - the
# route cursor - of the unit at manager+0x404.
# Every campaign mission has one. Counts are 1 or 3, and 3 is exactly the
# multi-operation missions. word3 is not the array index: entry 11 has 0, 2, 3.
# columns: pac_entry mission slot x y z word3
